# Support

- **Documentation:** the [README](../README.md) covers installation, the modules, profiles and settings. On a server,
  `lss info MODULE` shows what a module does and which settings it reads.
- **Bugs:** open an [issue](https://github.com/VectoDE/Linux-Server-Setup-Script/issues/new/choose) with the bug
  template.
- **Questions and ideas:** use [Discussions](https://github.com/VectoDE/Linux-Server-Setup-Script/discussions).
- **Security problems:** follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md). Never post them publicly.

This is a free tool maintained in spare time. There is no guaranteed response time and no commercial support.
